description: Reads whether live streaming is connected on the connected site: the install-wide 100ms connection (app credentials or a manual token, and whether a room can be created) and the Daily.co connection (key and domain), plus, for one webinar, its own room state and which video source its room uses. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it when the host asks whether their live room is connected, why the room shows no video, or before connecting a provider (that is wi_connect_streaming). Both providers are read in one call, so the answer covers whichever the host uses. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, to read that campaign's own room state.

name: wi_get_streaming_status
title: Read the live streaming state
